quarterly_data.quarter: L3Harris press release: L3Harris Opens NextGeneration Solid Rocket Motor Facility (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris opened the new Arsenal of Freedom solid rocket motor production facility in Camden, Arkansas, designed to double current capacity with additional growth available, supporting production for the U.S. Army's GMLRS. Its completion is part of a $216 million Defense Production Act Title III cooperative agreement signed with the Department of War in 2023 (new facilities at Camden and Orange County, Virginia, and equipment and digital upgrades at Huntsville, Alabama) for tactical missiles including Javelin, Stinger and GMLRS. L3Harris is investing billions across Arkansas, California, Virginia and Alabama, building approximately 60 new facilities, which it expects to help double, triple and quadruple propulsion production rates for key programs.
quarterly_data.figure: designed to double current capacity; $216 million cooperative agreement (2023); approximately 60 new facilities
